fixes: canvas.js:persistMovedDomain — domainExclusiveAtPointerDown; reverseNav only on true second click
styles.css — overview .domain z-index:19 above .edges (18); focus is-focus z-index:22

evidence.test: selects domain from canvas header click (not tree)
